act_name: Protection of Women (Criminal Laws Amendment) Act, 2006 (Act VI of 2006)
title: Procedure in cases of zina and fornication under Pakistan Penal Code
verbatim_text: No court shall take cognizance of an offence under section 496-B or section 496-C of the Pakistan Penal Code (fornication or false accusation) except on a complaint lodged in a Court of Session by the person aggrieved or competent authority, and no police officer shall investigate such complaint without an express direction of the Court of Session.
provisos: Provided that the Court of Session shall not issue process against the accused unless it has examined at least four credible eye-witnesses of good character on oath.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Protection of Women (Criminal Laws Amendment) Act, 2006 (Act VI of 2006)
